description: The unlock note promises 'you can set up the webhook' but the app actually continues on its own; the user may click Add webhook again or wonder if it worked.
actual: Note wording implies a further step.
suggested_fix: Reword: 'Setup of the OpenRouter webhook continues after you unlock.'

description: After the automatic resume, focus lands on the 'Copy' button of the npm install command, not on the new token's copy buttons.
expected: Focus on the new token block, or the dialog title.
actual: First Copy button focused (visible ring on the install command).
suggested_fix: Move focus to the Webhook URL copy button (or announce the token with aria-live) when the token appears.

description: The key-status menu offers both 'Lock' and 'Lock this browser' with no explanation of the difference; also the vault stays unlocked across a page reload, which a user may not expect.
expected: One lock action, or a one-line description of each.
actual: Two similar items in the Unlocked menu.
suggested_fix: Merge or describe the two items.
